recommendation.selection_rationale: Six swimsuit scenes with blue, white, green, terracotta and burgundy color variation, breakfast, seated, reclined, walking, rear-angle and greenhouse poses; four clothed frames add cool-weather city, dance action, a full-body seaside walk and landscape dinner. The coast frame is appropriate with a mild/warm resort setting, without inventing verified local November weather.
recommendation.editorial_sequence_note: The proposed order is an editorial sequence only. It does not establish an actual chronology, travel itinerary, location, weather or real-world event.

minimum_six_complete_two_piece_bikini_al.note: This stricter alternative uses 11–16, all showing both bikini pieces, at the cost of a second frontal indoor-pool walking motif. Source 15 was visually screened and is a usable reserve.

recommendation.release_dependency: Root/editor must complete durable archival and immutable readback, any required provenance gates, final derivative/JPEG QA, captions and normal independent publication review before counting as accepted publishable stock.
